safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the LLQ crampy pain has no radiation slightly reduces diagnostic detail but is unlikely to change immediate management in an uncomplicated acute diarrhea presentation. This is unlikely to alter triage, testing, or treatment decisions on its own.
